review.assessment: The change introduces makeGrid by using Array.fill with a single pre-allocated inner array, which fails to instantiate independent rows. Consequently, any mutation to one row propagates identically across all other rows. This directly violates the task specification requiring each row to be an independent array.

findings.call: Run makeGrid(2, 2), set grid[0][0] = 5, log grid[1][0]
findings.defect: Shared row references cause cross-row mutation
